claim: When Direct PUT is the data source, each Firehose stream provides a combined quota for PutRecord and PutRecordBatch requests of 500,000 records/second, 2,000 requests/second and 5 MiB/second in US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon) and Europe (Ireland), and 100,000 records/second, 1,000 requests/second and 1 MiB/second in other AWS Regions. If a Direct PUT stream is throttled, Firehose automatically increases the stream's throughput limit until the throttling is contained; for sudden large bursts, or a new stream that needs more than the default throughput limit, you request an increase. The three quotas scale proportionally. When Kinesis Data Streams is the data source, this quota does not apply.

qualifiers.scope: per Firehose stream, Direct PUT source, by Region
qualifiers.condition: applies when Direct PUT is the data source; does not apply when Kinesis Data Streams is the source; Firehose raises the limit automatically under throttling, and you can request an increase; the three quotas scale proportionally

evidence.quote: When **Direct PUT** is configured as the data source, each Firehose stream provides the following combined quota for [PutRecord](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/APIReference/API_PutRecord.html) and [PutRecordBatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/APIReference/API_PutRecordBatch.html) requests:
For US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), and Europe (Ireland): 500,000 records/second, 2,000 requests/second, and 5 MiB/second.
For other AWS Regions: 100,000 records/second, 1,000 requests/second, and 1 MiB/second.

If a Direct PUT stream experiences throttling due to higher data ingest volumes that exceed the throughput capacity of a Firehose stream, Amazon Data Firehose automatically increases the throughput limit of the stream until the throttling is contained.
If you expect the data volume to increase in sudden large bursts, or if your new stream needs a higher throughput than the default throughput limit, request to increase the throughput limit.
There is three quota scale proportionally for quotas.
When Kinesis Data Streams is configured as the data source, this quota doesn't apply, and Amazon Data Firehose scales up and down with no limit.
